name: Lifting the Curse
summary: First Mate Fitzsimmons seeks to free his fallen crewmates from a restless curse. He believes a dark artifact aboard the wrecked Intrepid binds them, and Captain Halyndor's ghost guards the key to its strongbox.

sections.title: A Captain's Burden
sections.body: First Mate Fitzsimmons survived the Third Fleet's fate, but memories of his comrades haunt him by day and by night. He believes an evil object locked in the Intrepid's strongbox is tied to the undeath gripping his shipmates. The wreck is watched by Captain Halyndor, whose ghost guards the key to the strongbox.

sections.title: Unlocking the Depths
sections.body: The Third Fleet's broken ships lie off the northern Wetlands coast. Inside the flooded hull of the Intrepid, a locked strongbox holds the relic at the heart of the crew's misery. To reach it, you face Halyndor's ghost on deck, take the rusted key, and enter the flooded hull. The artifact must be recovered so holy hands can cleanse it.

faq.q: What ship are you searching during this quest?
faq.answer: You are searching the Intrepid, a sunken ship of the Third Fleet off the northwestern Wetlands shore.
Captain Halyndor commanded the Intrepid. His restless ghost haunts the ruined ship's deck and guards the key to its strongbox.

faq.q: Why does First Mate Fitzsimmons want the strongbox opened?
faq.answer: Fitzsimmons believes a cursed object in the strongbox traps his fellow sailors' spirits in torment. He wants it opened so the artifact can be recovered and purified.

faq.q: Where is the Intrepid's strongbox located?
faq.answer: The Intrepid's strongbox lies submerged in the lower hull, reached through a breach in the wreck's side beneath the waves.

faq.q: Who can cleanse the cursed object once it is recovered?
faq.answer: Fitzsimmons directs you to bring the recovered object to Glorin Steelbrow, a dwarven priest in Menethil Harbor, for cleansing.

faq.q: What caused the shipwreck in the first place?
faq.answer: During the Second War, orc-controlled red dragons attacked the Third Fleet, burning and sinking its ships off the Wetlands coast. A cursed treasure aboard now keeps the drowned crews from rest.

angles.text: As a priest, you have the spiritual authority to address afflictions and cleanse tainted relics. Fitzsimmons entrusts the strongbox's contents to the priesthood for purification.
As an Alliance champion, you honor the sailors who served the Alliance in life by helping lay their tortured souls to rest while traveling through Menethil Harbor.
